rows.en: We've received a mission request from Commander Misumaru.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum briefing officer

rows.en: This nation's head of state is Relena Peacecraft, a key figure in Earth's peace faction.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum briefing officer

rows.en: It seems OZ intends to kill her to strengthen its position on Earth.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum briefing officer

rows.en: If the peace faction grows strong around her, a popular figure, Earth could tip to peace.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum briefing officer

rows.en: So this is why Commander Misumaru asked us to protect her...
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum briefing officer

rows.en: She has the qualities to lead the next era. We will guard her with all our strength.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum briefing officer

rows.en: All pilots, <mk(0,-50,4,0)><ar(0,4,0)>support the <pic(1)><cs(3)>units in combat<ce()> and stop the enemy from entering the city.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum briefing officer

rows.en: I regret that it had to be settled this way, but I thank you all for what you have done.
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft

rows.en: An era where peace is at the mercy of force... It seems it's time I steeled my resolve.
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft

rows.en: I hate to ask when you've only just saved me, but I have a request for all of you.
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft

rows.en: Would you be willing to take me to the UCE Parliament?
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft

rows.en: There, I intend to make an appeal to the people of the world.
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft

rows.en: I have a duty to do what only I can do.
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft

rows.en: Will the day ever come when an age of peace arrives...
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft?
